title: Pip's Goodnight Song
yt_description:
Teach your child a gentle bedtime routine with Pip. Learn to say goodnight to the sun and the stars. This soothing song helps toddlers wind down and get ready for sleep.

🎵 Pip's Goodnight Song

Pip says
goodnight sun

Stars are
shining bright

Goodnight
sleep tight

Goodnight
sleep tight

Pip sleeps
tight too

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.

#Shorts #KidsSongs #bedtime #goodnight #sleep
